entry.content:

  • Skin Ticket x8：₺149,99

Application Description

Build the dungeon. Set the traps. Wait for the heroes. Skel & Defense is a dungeon defense roguelike where you play the villain. Expand your dungeon room by room, fill it with deadly traps, transform into Skel, and stop wave after wave of heroes coming for your treasure. Combine the strategy of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike, and build a dungeon no adventuring party can survive. ◆ Become the Dungeon Master, Not the Hero Every dungeon has a monster waiting in the darkness. This time, that monster is you. At night, expand your dungeon and prepare your traps. During the day, defend the gates against waves of invading heroes. Build, defend, improve, and repeat. Turn a humble underground tomb into an unstoppable fortress. ◆ 26 Trap Rooms, Countless Combinations Build and combine 26 unique trap rooms, including fireballs, lava zones, freezing mist, icicles, saw blades, poison arrows, electromagnetic fields, and more. Combine rooms of the same element to unlock powerful synergies. Freeze enemies before burning them alive. Trap them in narrow corridors and finish them with poison. Your dungeon layout determines how long the heroes survive. ◆ Transform into Skel and Fight Traps are not your only weapon. Transform into different Skels and fight the invaders yourself. Become a Mage Skel and launch fireballs from the rear, a Rogue Skel throwing shurikens, or a Shield Skel holding the front line. When your traps are not enough, finish the job yourself. ◆ 7 Stages, Endless Mode, Global Rankings Conquer 7 stages with different rewards, then enter Endless Mode and face increasingly powerful waves. How long can your dungeon survive? Register a nickname in the options menu to join the global rankings and compete with players around the world. ◆ Over 30 Perks, A Different Run Every Time Choose from more than 30 perks during each stage. Take powerful upgrades to strengthen your build, or accept dangerous penalties in exchange for bonus score. Focus entirely on traps, strengthen your Skel, or combine both approaches. Every run is different, and every decision matters. ◆ Grow Stronger with Every Run Defeat waves to earn Trait Points and unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs stronger. Explore the Collection to uncover hidden synergies, new rooms, and powerful relics. There is always one more strategy to discover. ◆ Full Controller Support Prefer playing with a controller? Build rooms, choose perks, use the shop, warp through the dungeon, browse the Collection, and control every major screen with a gamepad. On-screen button prompts are supported, and you can freely switch between controller and touch controls. ◆ A Premium Dungeon Defense Built for Replayability Short runs. Deep strategy. And that feeling of wanting to survive just one more wave. • Dungeon defense combined with roguelike progression • 26 trap rooms with elemental synergies • Multiple Skel forms for direct combat • 7 stages plus an increasingly difficult Endless Mode • Global ranking competition • More than 30 perks that change every run • Permanent upgrades, relics, and hidden synergies • Full gamepad support • Cloud save support • Playable in 13 languages If you enjoy tower defense games, roguelikes and roguelites, dungeon management, base defense, strategy games, or survivor-style action, Skel & Defense was built for you. The heroes are already coming. Build your dungeon, prepare your traps, and show them who the real master of the dungeon is.

Application Description

A corruptive presence has invaded the Federal Bureau of Control… Only you have the power to stop it. The world is now your weapon in an epic fight to annihilate an ominous enemy through deep and unpredictable environments. Containment has failed, humanity is at stake. Will you regain control? Winner of over 80 awards, CONTROL is a visually stunning third-person action-adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Blending open-ended environments with the signature world-building and storytelling of renowned developer, Remedy Entertainment, CONTROL presents an expansive and intensely gratifying gameplay experience. CONTROL Ultimate Edition has now been adapted to iOS. We have implemented touch controls and made changes to the in-game UI and game mechanics, like aiming and puzzles to provide a great experience for supported touch devices. The game renders beautifully through Metal and supports Ray Tracing on supported hardware. Key features UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES: Can you handle the bureau’s dark secrets? Unfold an epic supernatural struggle, filled with unexpected characters and bizarre events, as you search for your missing brother, and discover the truth that has brought you here. EVERYTHING IS YOUR WEAPON: Unleash destruction through transforming weaponry and telekinetic powers. Discover new ways to annihilate your enemies as you harness powerful abilities to turn everything around you into a lethal weapon. EXPLORE A HIDDEN WORLD: Delve deep into the ominous expanses of a secretive government agency. Explore the Bureau’s shifting environments only to discover that there is always more than meets the eye… FIGHT FOR CONTROL: Battle a relentless enemy through exciting missions and challenging boss fights to earn powerful upgrades that maximize abilities and customize your weaponry. CONTROL Ultimate Edition on iOS supports the following MetalFX features: MetalFX TAAU - Temporal Anti-Aliasing and upscaling MetalFX Frame Interpolation Ray-Tracing is supported on devices with M3+ or A19 Pro with 10Gb of memory.

Application Description

A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps. This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher. Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done. You get: - Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps - Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need - Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message - Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand - Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus - Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision - Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities - Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions - Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price. With Goblin Tools Pro, you can: - Keep your data continuously synced between devices - Create and reuse templates for to-do items - Share the lists you create - Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice - Access your history across all Goblin Tools - Use additional Pro features as they are introduced Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate. It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more. Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

Dominate the dungeon. Or let it dominate you. A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge! Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending. ■ Unique Heroes — Not just different stats. A completely different way to play. Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count. Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash devastating area attacks. Defense is offense. Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy. Noble: +1 level-up choice, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon. …Every hero demands a different strategy. ■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy. Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations. ■ Powerful Relics — Sometimes a single relic changes everything. Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25% Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop ■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die. Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases. ■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here. Normal mode is only the beginning. As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await. Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty. Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations. ■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week. Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week. Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work. Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings. Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle. How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger? ■ Endless Replayability 3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike. ■ Features Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies Procedurally generated dungeons Multiple languages supported Cloud save Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy. One run is never enough.
